_provenance.basis: Synthetic. Position structure modelled on a tri-party collateral safekeeping statement; break classes modelled on the standard collateral reconciliation exception types.
_provenance.warning: SIMULATED DATA - not real institutional data.
_provenance.identifiers: Asset identifiers are ISIN-shaped and are not real ISINs. Custodian names, BICs, account numbers, counterparties and staff names are invented.

tolerance_note: A market value difference at or below this tolerance is a rounding or vendor-pricing artefact and reconciles as MATCHED. Above it, the row is a break. Injected PRICE_NOISE_WITHIN_TOLERANCE rows exist to prove the tolerance is applied rather than ignored.
rate_note: Two rates, deliberately separated. exception_rate is what a reconciliation should raise. noise_rate is within-tolerance price disagreement that it should absorb silently. A single blended figure would flatter any engine that raises everything.

injection_classes.label: Valuation difference inside tolerance
injection_classes.mechanic: Custodian price moved by 1-4 basis points against the internal mark. Two vendors pricing the same bond will not agree to the last cent.
injection_classes.expected_outcome: MATCHED. The difference is at or below the 5 bp tolerance and must not be raised as a break.

injection_classes.label: Valuation difference outside tolerance
injection_classes.mechanic: Custodian price moved by 40-350 basis points. Typically a stale vendor feed or a disputed mark on an illiquid line.
injection_classes.expected_outcome: MISMATCH on market value. Must be raised.

injection_classes.label: Nominal difference
injection_classes.mechanic: Custodian nominal is 55-95% of the internal nominal — a partial settlement where only part of the delivery reached the account.
injection_classes.expected_outcome: MISMATCH on nominal and market value. Must be raised.

injection_classes.label: Present internally, absent at the custodian
injection_classes.mechanic: Row removed from the custodian statement. The classic settlement-in-flight break: the bank has booked a delivery the custodian has not yet received.
injection_classes.expected_outcome: MISSING_EXTERNAL. Must be raised and aged.

injection_classes.label: Custodian priced as of the prior business day
injection_classes.mechanic: Custodian row carries the previous day's price and a price_as_of of T-1. The size of the resulting difference depends on the asset class's daily volatility, so some stale marks fall inside tolerance and some do not — which is exactly the ambiguity a real screen must handle.
injection_classes.expected_outcome: MISMATCH where the move exceeds tolerance, MATCHED where it does not. price_as_of is the evidence either way.

injection_classes.label: Booked to a sibling safekeeping account
injection_classes.mechanic: Custodian booked the position to a different account at the same custodian. Benign as a keying error; the shape of a misappropriation if it is not.
injection_classes.expected_outcome: MISSING_EXTERNAL on the expected account and MISSING_INTERNAL on the receiving account. A reconciliation that nets these two into 'matched' has hidden the finding.

injection_classes.label: Currency code disagrees
injection_classes.mechanic: Custodian reports the position in a different currency code while the amount is unchanged. An edge case that breaks naive comparison, because the numbers match and the values do not.
injection_classes.expected_outcome: MISMATCH. Comparing amounts without comparing currency is the defect this case exists to catch.

injection_classes.label: Present at the custodian, absent internally
injection_classes.mechanic: 3 custodian rows added on accounts the internal ledger does not carry - an unexpected receipt.

matching_note: Account plus asset is the natural key a collateral team reconciles on. It is deliberately not position_id: the custodian has never seen the bank's internal position identifier, which is what makes the ACCOUNT_MISDIRECTION case detectable at all.
planned_vs_injected: planned_rows is how many positions each class was applied to. injected_rows is how many produced an observable difference. They differ where a price move landed on a zero-nominal position, which values at zero on both sides: no difference exists, so none is claimed in the answer key.
edge_cases: Zero-nominal positions, fully returned or amortised.
Odd lots with fractional nominals, left by partial returns.
A three-currency book: USD, EUR and INR amounts are not summable without an FX conversion, and the reconciliation does not perform one.
Uneven custodian concentration - one custodian holds most of the book.
scoring: Treat 'breaks' below as ground truth. Precision and recall over the raised exceptions measure a reconciliation engine; a row listed as PRICE_NOISE_WITHIN_TOLERANCE that is raised as a break is a false positive, not a catch.
